arena_evaluation_note: No new CHIMERA Arena evaluation was run for Gate 3.5 model selection.

selection.rationale: The selected candidate has the best untouched-holdout probability quality under the fixed rule; Arena revenue and action diversity were not consulted.
selection.rule: minimum holdout Brier, then maximum holdout PR-AUC, then minimum train-holdout Brier gap, then simpler fixed candidate order

training_protocol.protocol: fit on training; fit Platt calibration on validation; freeze candidates; evaluate holdout once; no Arena evaluation
